# BLO-40611 — bump the vendored lockfile's `source-map-js` to 1.2.2 (GHSA-68fv-2mgg-jv7q)

Changed files:

- `package-lock.json` — `node_modules/source-map-js` moves `1.2.1` → `1.2.2`
  (`resolved` and `integrity` with it). Regenerated with
  `npm update source-map-js --package-lock-only`, not hand-edited; nothing else
  in the lockfile moved, and `package.json` is unchanged.

Why: GHSA-68fv-2mgg-jv7q / CVE-2026-93749 (event-loop DoS through indexed
source-map section offsets) covers `>= 1.0.0, < 1.2.2`. The root
`pnpm.overrides` floor added in the same PR cannot reach this directory — it is
outside the pnpm workspace and carries its own npm lockfile, installed with
`npm ci` — so this is a second, independent resolution of the same advisory.

Exposure was dev-only: the entry is `"dev": true`, reached through
`@vitest/coverage-v8` → `magicast` and `vitest` → `vite` → `postcss`, both
declaring `^1.2.1`, so `1.2.2` is a drop-in. No runtime artifact shipped it.

No upstream change, and no version bump: this is a lockfile refresh, not a
carried patch against an upstream adapter release.
